label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Compiled walk records (assets/walks/walks.json): each DOC walk page read in full into structured ways, huts and access points with verbatim quotes, checked by tools/walks/validate.py, then followed over the map's tracks and checked by WalkCompiler (places reached in order, no detours, covers 75% of DOC's line, fits DOC's time, distance within 50%, loops close, huts on the way). 145 walks compiled so far: 93 verified are shown as compiled (start/end choices, DOC legs, the page's own hut list); 52 flagged show DOC's own line. Walks without a reading keep the 0.1.54 behaviour.
Greenstone and Caples Track lists its three huts: Mid Caples, McKellar and Greenstone.
Description photos use DOC's larger linked image, drawn at most 1.5x their pixels (from the unpublished 0.1.55).
Fix found before release: the records are shipped as plain walks.json (the build unpacks .gz assets, so the .gz name would not have been found); a unit test now loads the shipped asset.
dataChecks: compile-report.json and review.html: every compiled walk with its status, flags and a map (DOC's line, the compiled ways, huts).

tests.kotlinJvm: 285 tests; PriorityPipelineTest timing case failed once under full-suite load and passed 3 of 3 alone; new: shipped records load, Greenstone huts
